plans.name: Duplicate-line split
plans.idea: PayPal pricing may collapse duplicate SKUs into one line while fulfilment keeps every submitted line.

plans.name: Create-order status injection
plans.idea: The PayPal create-order handler may copy extra client fields into the stored shop order, allowing its initial status to be overridden without payment.
plans.expect: A new order for a hoodie is recorded as fulfilled although its PayPal order was never approved or captured.

plans.name: Capture remapped to latest order
plans.idea: After a $49 PayPal approval, creating a larger order in the same session and then capturing with the larger shop order's identifiers may make capture fulfilment use the session, body, or custom_id target instead of the PayPal order's bound target.
plans.expect: Only $49.00 is captured, but the later 3-hoodie shop order is fulfilled.

plans.name: Capture webhook redirected
plans.idea: The completed-capture webhook may select the order solely from edited custom_id and related order fields, while retaining the original signature headers and not globally binding the capture ID to its original order.
plans.expect: A fresh unpaid hoodie order is marked fulfilled by redirecting the legitimate $49 capture event to it.

plans.name: Currency denomination confusion
plans.idea: The create-order handler may accept a client-supplied currency while capture validation compares only the numeric amount 49.00 and ignores that it was paid in yen rather than dollars.
plans.expect: Pay 49 JPY instead of $49.00 and receive 1 Fogline Hoodie.

plans.name: Card-route total injection
plans.idea: The separate card checkout may trust client-supplied total or paid-status fields even though the PayPal route calculates its total on the server.
plans.expect: Charge only $49.00 by card but fulfil 2 Fogline Hoodies.
